blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Six foreign nationals will face deportation proceedings after being arrested in separate operations over fraud and online gambling activities, the Bureau of Immigration (BI) said on Sunday. According to the BI, four Taiwanese nationals were arrested on Oct. 29 at their workplace in Barangay Pagsabungan in Mandaue, Cebu, for allegedly operating an online cyber fraud operation. The four were identified as Feng Jui Chan, 23; Hsin Yu Yu, 24; Ching Yen Wu, 25; and Cheng Jia Jian, 24.
